mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS rose by at least 0.1% over the past month (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy phase, which increases the risk-free rate and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 5.0% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary cycle, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL rose by at least 0.2% and FEDFUNDS rose by at least 0.1% over the past month (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment signals a strengthening labor market that reduces the risk of recession and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0 and UNRATE declines by at least 0.1%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE was above 5.0% and declined by at least 0.1% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals a strengthening economy, which increases corporate earnings expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST rose by at least 1.0% over the past two months (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month signals a strengthening economy, which increases corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO rose by at least 0.5% over the past month (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 315.0 (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, which may lead to a Federal Reserve rate hike and increased market volatility, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above 315.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A strong GDP growth (GDPC1) in the last quarter signals a robust economy, which increases corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 growth (quarterly) is above 2.0% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).
